organization.description: A company, team, institution, or community.

activity.description: A project, task, event, or habit.

concept.description: A reusable topic, skill, style, or stable characteristic.

artifact.description: A concrete work, object, device, or other created item.

knows.description: A stable social connection between people.

affiliated_with.description: Employment, membership, or another stable affiliation.

located_in.description: The subject is located in a place now or during the stated interval.

involved_in.description: Participation in a project, task, event, or habit.

interested_in.description: An ongoing interest in a subject, activity, or artifact.

avoids.description: A persistent aversion, prohibition, allergy, or active avoidance.

created.description: Authorship, creation, or initiation of a work or activity.

has_trait.description: A stable, reusable characteristic of the subject.

part_of.description: A compositional or membership relationship between structured entities.

broader_than.description: A concept is broader in meaning than another concept.
